environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on EC2 behind AWS ALB. WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL includes a custom rule group 'task-api-protection' with priority 1 that inspects POST request bodies to /api/v1/tasks/* paths. The rule uses a ByteMatchStatement checking for gob-encoded binary content with a SizeConstraintStatement limiting request body to 256 bytes AND a RegexPatternSetReferenceStatement that matches against decoded field patterns containing shell metacharacters (|, ;, &&, $( , `) in the body bytes. The rule action is BLOCK with custom response code 403. Additionally, the WebACL has AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet enabled at priority 2 which includes the JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY rule in COUNT mode (not BLOCK). The custom rule group uses a transformation chain of URL_DECODE followed by BASE64_DECODE on the body field before pattern matching. CloudWatch metrics are enabled for the WebACL with sampled requests.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.network: public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0, all outbound allowed
